description.text: Undergraduates need to learn their major in Chinese after one-year Chinese language study.

duration.text: The Material Science and Engineering at Wuhan University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents Undergraduate school transcript

requirements.text: Undergraduates need to learn their major in Chinese after one-year Chinese language study. For students who have basic knowlege of Chinese, don't need to attend the one-year Chinese language study but need to have HSK Band 3 Certificate..
